title: Prominence on 30A Rayburn House Prominence on 30A
meta_description: Prominence 30A Rayburn House - Beach, Golf Cart, 4 Bikes, 2 Pools, The Big Chill
description_expanded: AboutProminence on 30A – Rayburn House by Panhandle Getaways is a vacation home in Watersound, FL, featuring stylish interiors, a quiet location near the pool, resort-style amenities, and easy access to The Big Chill’s restaurants, shops, and live entertainment. Welcome to Rayburn House, a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom vacation home in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways. Perfect for couples or small groups, this coastal retreat offers a bright, open living area, a fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar, and two king bedrooms for ultimate comfort. Spend your days exploring 30A on the included golf cart or bikes, relaxing by the nearby pool, and enjoying the peaceful charm of this beautiful 30A getaway. TOWNHOME FEATURES • 2-bedroom townhome located on 30A • Golf cart included (gas-powered) • 4 bikes included for exploring 30A’s 17-mile bike path • Spacious living area with ample seating and 55" TV • Fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar • Dining area • Bedroom 1: King bed, 40" TV, en suite bathroom • Bedroom 2: King bed, 40" TV • Bathroom 2: Tub/shower combo • Full-size washer and dryer • Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi • Backpack beach chairs provided for guest use • Peaceful location near the pool • Perfect for couples with two king bedrooms • Sleeps up to 4 guests ABOUT PROMINENCE ON 30A - WATERSOUND, FL Prominence on 30A is one of the most popular communities along Scenic Highway 30A, offering incredible amenities, open green spaces, and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Perfectly located near 30A favorites and the area’s sugar-white beaches, Prominence features a charming town center and two resort-style pools. At the heart of it all, The Big Chill is a lively gathering place featuring an outdoor 25-foot LED theater screen for concerts, movie nights, and sporting events, as well as boutique shops, family-friendly activities, and excellent dining options. Centrally situated between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east, Prominence places you right in the middle of everything that makes 30A special. COMMUNITY & THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES • Two resort-style zero-entry pools – perfect for all ages • Walking distance to The Big Chill – dining, shops, and nightly entertainment • Luke Bryan’s cigar and gastro pub – a favorite local hangout • Family movie nights and live sports on the outdoor big screen • Onsite ice machine and barbecue grilling areas • Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seaside • 3.5 miles to the nearest grocery store 30A PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS POINTS Beach access for all Prominence homes is available through South Walton public beach access points. Most guests use Deer Lake State Park or other nearby public accesses along 30A. Please note that Prominence homes do not have direct beach access through Watersound Club and do not include access to Watersound private club facilities. FREE DAILY ACTIVITIES INCLUDED Guests enjoy FREE daily activities through our Xplorie partnership: • 1 FREE round of golf each day at 1 of 4 nearby courses (year-round) • 4 bikes ready to ride (year-round) • 1 FREE dolphin cruise or snorkel trip per day (March–October) NOTICE • This home has a surveillance device at the front door and an AirTag on the golf cart, which may send a notification to the driver’s cell device indicating the cart is being tracked. • The community’s pool heating schedule is determined by the HOA and is subject to change at any time. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any changes to pool heating or availability. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION A starter pack of toiletries, paper products, and detergents is provided for your arrival. Guests should plan to purchase additional supplies for the remainder of their stay. Bed linens and bath towels are included; please bring beach towels for pool and beach use. WHY WE LOVE IT Experience the best of 30A living at Rayburn House, where modern comfort meets coastal charm. Spend your days cruising to the beach or The Big Chill by golf cart or bike, then unwind by the pool or on your private patio surrounded by peaceful scenery. Thoughtfully designed and ideally located, this getaway makes it easy to relax, explore, and enjoy the simple pleasures of life on 30A.
